description: Evaluate an action before execution: would policy allow it right now? The action is the capability it uses: voice.outbound (a call), sms.send (a text), calls.transfer (a hand-off) or purchases (a purchase: pass merchant and amount_cents).

amount_cents.description: purchases: what it would cost, in cents

body.description: sms.send: message content for a segment/cost estimate

call.description: call_… id: the call to hand off (required for calls.transfer)

line.description: line_… id the action would use (default: your only Line)

merchant.description: purchases: who you would buy from

purpose.description: What it is for, e.g. scheduling

name: ordan.policy.check
title: Check an action against policy
